text.tspan: Polio case and death rates in the United States
The reported rates are per 100,000 US population and include both wild- and vaccine-derived poliovirus
infections that occurred indigenously and as imported cases.

tspan.tspan: Our World In Data based on US Public Health Service; US Center for Disease Control; and WHO
Until 1983, the data includes all reported polio cases; from 1984, paralytic cases only. Case rates for 2024 and 2025, and the death rate
